title: Write the doc-link rule into the agent contract and document the key
action: Teach the contract and the reference that doc references become viewer URLs when doc_viewer is configured. (1) AGENTS.md :135-136 -- the Communication paragraph that says 'link records instead of pasting them' gains the clause. (2) packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md :128-129 -- THE SAME EDIT, VERBATIM. That block is what onboarding splices into every host project's AGENTS.md (onboard/source.rs:49 -> onboard/merge.rs:23); its managed body is byte-identical to the root file's, and editing only the root withholds the rule from every project that would actually set the key. (3) skills/bee-hive/references/routing-and-contracts.md:200 -- the same rule in the Communication contract's craft paragraph, beside 'make a win runnable by naming the command or path'. (4) Re-render the skill trees IN THIS CELL: devtools/skill_trees.rs:996 byte-compares a fresh render of skills/ against the committed plugin trees, so a skills/ edit without `bee dev render-skill-trees` turns this cell's own verify red. The two self-install copies (.claude/skills/, .agents/skills/, with their sha256 sidecars) are refreshed by the installer rather than that command -- refresh them too and commit all four trees. (5) docs/config-reference.md -- a doc_viewer row in the `## Other keys` table (:154-166) plus a short section: the two fields, the layout, what a half-set key does, and the one limit (a path containing spaces must be percent-escaped by whoever writes the link; bee joins, it does not encode). (6) .bee/config-sample.json -- BOTH shapes the sample carries per key, the annotation string and the live value (ship_visibility shows the pair at :28 and :80). (7) REGEN CHAIN, inside this cell, in this order: bee dev render-skill-trees, then bee onboard --repo-root . --apply, then bee dev release-manifest --write -- packages/bee is a root the release manifest hashes, so touching AGENTS.block.md owes the regen and the refreshed manifest is part of this cell's diff.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml && bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: the doc-link rule reads identically in AGENTS.md and packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md, so an onboarded host project receives it
render_matches_the_committed_trees passes -- all four skill trees committed in step with the skills/ edit
docs/config-reference.md documents doc_viewer in the Other keys table and in its own section, including half-set behavior and the no-encoding limit
.bee/config-sample.json carries doc_viewer as both an annotation string and a live value
